    Coefficient-quiver representations #

    A coefficient quiver over monomial data D is a finite set of positions, each lying over a vertex, together with, for every arrow a, a partial map next a on positions and nonzero coefficients: the arrow sends the basis vector of position i to coef a i times the basis vector of next a i.

    If no directed walk in the coefficient quiver spells a zero path (KillsZeroPaths), the induced representation on P → k is a representation of D (toRep), hence an A-module. String modules and the one-dimensional band modules are of this form.

    Type (max 1 u_1)

    A coefficient quiver: positions over vertices and arrow moves with scalars.

    • P : Type

      Positions.

    • fin : Fintype self.P
    • dec : DecidableEq self.P
    • vtx : self.P → D.Q.V

      The vertex of a position.

    • next : D.Q.A → self.P → Option self.P

      Where an arrow sends a position, if anywhere.

    • coef : D.Q.A → self.P → k

      The coefficient of an arrow move.

    • next_src (a : D.Q.A) (i j : self.P) : self.next a i = some j → self.vtx i = D.Q.src a
    • next_tgt (a : D.Q.A) (i j : self.P) : self.next a i = some j → self.vtx j = D.Q.tgt a
